description: DNSSEC check for a domain: whether a DS record exists at the parent zone (the domain is signed), and whether two public validating resolvers (AdGuard DNS, NextDNS) return its A answer with the AD (authenticated) flag. It reads the resolvers' verdict; it does not validate the signature chain itself. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_dnssec_validator
title: Security Dnssec Validator
